item.title: Modern SQLite: Features You Didn't Know It Had
item.description:

Example: extracting fields from a JSON column: CREATE TABLE events ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL -- JSON ); SELECT json_extract(payload, '$. Full-text search with FTS5 SQLite’s FTS5 extension turns it into a capable full-text search engine.
